The mechanical alloying was done using HEBM at different time intervals (0, 5, 10, 15, and 20 hours) under a closed atmosphere and constant flow with help of a stainless steel vial and balls of 10 mm diameter. The work parameters of the ball milling were 300 rpm with the ratio from ball to powder of 10:1 milled at 20 hours.

Finally, after 20 hours the milled powder was integrated through VHP (vacuum hot pressing) at temperature, pressure, the cooling rate of 1170°C, 60 MPa, 50°C/min and a vacuum level was maintained at 10−3 Torr.
